SUBJECT: Kael's Brazilian neighborhood home: warm creamy plaster, deep teal wooden paneled door and shutters, full terracotta tiled gable roof. Small navy eaves, cream window trim, tiny wall lamp. Family home, NO shop display.
View: same camera/elevation/orientation as first guide. Both ground axes precisely 2:1, verticals vertical, full gable roof two intact planes and covered rear, no perspective convergence. The visible front wall is LEFT facing; the right-facing wall is the side window. Door tall enough for an 84px character in a 126px wall; same door location as guide. No architecture redesign, no canopy, no steps or raised plinth/porch. Flat foundation at bottom follows EXACT guide diamond support polygon. Keep all art within guide's building silhouette, no plant pots or vegetation attached outside, no extra props. The source is a mechanical construction guide and should become hand-drawn high-quality game art: varied grouped barrel tiles with curved tile ends, tactile but simple plaster edge wear, chunky elegant ink, tiny door latch, warm wood trim, broad cel shading, clear eaves, base plus one shadow per material. Upper-left light, short contact shading only on building. No blurry watercolor, no vector wireframe look, no 3D render, no fake bevels, no noisy texture. Match second reference's appealing detailed anime game finish at real sprite scale.
OUTPUT: only ONE complete isolated house, centered with small transparent margins, TRUE transparent background, NO ground tile, NO cast ground shadow, NO labels/text/characters/other buildings. Preserve guide proportions instead of making a narrow tall tower. Entire roof, foundation and eaves must fit.
